test_verification.label: Testing
test_verification.description: Standard testing tools and configuration for the 27.04 cycle.

uses_ops_testing.label: Uses Ops Testing
uses_ops_testing.description: The charm's unit tests use the current ops.testing framework and no longer use the legacy Harness.

uses_gh_runners_unit_testing.label: GitHub-hosted unit testing
uses_gh_runners_unit_testing.description: Every CI job that runs the charm's unit tests uses a GitHub-hosted runner (for example ubuntu-latest). Any self-hosted unit-test job, including coverage jobs, fails this check.

uses_jubilant.label: Uses Jubilant
uses_jubilant.description: The charm's integration tests use Jubilant to drive Juju.

uses_tf_v1_provider.label: Terraform Juju provider v1
uses_tf_v1_provider.description: The charm's Terraform module requires version 1.x of the Juju Terraform provider.

uses_charm_ci.label: Uses charm-ci
uses_charm_ci.description: Integration tests run in CI through Canonical's charm-ci workflows rather than operator-workflows.

supports_canonical_k8s.label: Canonical Kubernetes configured
supports_canonical_k8s.description: Kubernetes charms run their charm-ci integration tests on Canonical Kubernetes. Not applicable to machine charms.

supports_juju_4.label: Juju 4 configured
supports_juju_4.description: charm-ci integration tests run against Juju 4 (the stable track set for the cycle).

supports_juju_lts.label: Juju LTS configured
supports_juju_lts.description: charm-ci integration tests run against the current Juju LTS (the stable track set for the cycle).

documentation.label: Documentation
documentation.description: Customized repository documentation and Canonical Sphinx Stack adoption.

readme_present.label: README customized
readme_present.description: README.md exists at the repository root and has real content, not just headings or the unchanged charm template.

contributing_present.label: CONTRIBUTING customized
contributing_present.description: CONTRIBUTING.md exists at the repository root and has real content, not just headings or the unchanged charm template.

has_security.label: SECURITY customized
has_security.description: SECURITY.md exists at the repository root and has real content. The standard PFE security policy template counts.

uses_sphinx_stack.label: Sphinx Stack version
uses_sphinx_stack.description: Version of the Canonical Sphinx Stack used for the documentation; blank means it is not used. Not applicable to snaps or to products whose documentation is maintained upstream.

diataxis_coverage_ai.label: Diataxis coverage (AI)
diataxis_coverage_ai.description: AI estimate (0-4) of how many Diataxis modes (tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation) the documentation covers. Informational only; does not affect medals.

security_ssdlc.label: Security
security_ssdlc.description: Dependency updates and effective default-branch protections.

renovate_enabled.label: Renovate onboarded
renovate_enabled.description: Renovate is set up and active: the repository has a Renovate configuration and an open Dependency Dashboard issue created by the Renovate bot. A configuration file alone does not count.

branch_protection_required_checks.label: Required checks enforced
branch_protection_required_checks.description: The default branch requires status checks to pass before merging, set through branch protection or an active repository or organization ruleset. Protection without required checks, or rulesets in Evaluate mode, do not count.

signed_commits_required.label: Signed commits required
signed_commits_required.description: The default branch requires signed commits, set through branch protection or an active repository or organization ruleset. Rulesets in Evaluate mode do not count.
